modules.title: Number Sense & Place Value
modules.summary: Consolidate whole number and decimal place value; powers of 10; rounding.

items.objective: Read, write and order numbers to 10,000,000 incl. decimals to 3 d.p.
items.success_criteria: Correctly compare and order mixed integers/decimals; place on number line.

items.objective: Round to powers of 10 and specified decimal places
items.success_criteria: Round appropriately; justify when rounding up/down.

modules.title: Operations with Integers & Decimals
modules.summary: Fluent calculation incl. negatives; multi-step word problems.

items.objective: Add/subtract integers including negatives
items.success_criteria: Accurate on number line and in context (temperature, elevation).

items.objective: Multiply/divide integers and decimals
items.success_criteria: Place decimal point correctly; estimate to check reasonableness.

modules.title: Fractions
modules.summary: Equivalence, simplification, four operations; mixed numbers.

items.objective: Find and use equivalent fractions; simplify
items.success_criteria: Use GCF to reduce; convert between improper and mixed.

items.objective: Add/subtract with unlike denominators
items.success_criteria: Find common denominators accurately; simplify answers.

items.objective: Multiply/divide fractions and mixed numbers
items.success_criteria: Multiply numerators/denominators; invert-and-multiply for division; simplify.

modules.title: Decimals & Percentages
modules.summary: Convert between forms; percentage of amounts; percentage change.

items.objective: Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages
items.success_criteria: Use common benchmarks e.g. 1/2, 1/4, 0.2, 0.125, 12.5%.

items.objective: Calculate % of a quantity incl. increase/decrease
items.success_criteria: Use multipliers; interpret in context incl. discounts/tax.

modules.title: Ratio & Proportion
modules.summary: Simplifying ratios, unitary method, scaling recipes and maps.

items.objective: Simplify and share in a given ratio
items.success_criteria: Check totals and parts; use bar models for reasoning.

items.objective: Solve direct proportion problems
items.success_criteria: Use unitary multiplier; scale up/down accurately.

modules.title: Algebraic Expressions
modules.summary: Notation, like terms, expansion and factorisation.

items.objective: Form and simplify expressions
items.success_criteria: Collect like terms; substitute integer values reliably.

items.objective: Expand and factorise single brackets
items.success_criteria: Correct use of distributive law; factor common factors.

modules.title: Linear Equations & Inequalities
modules.summary: Solve one- and two-step equations; represent and solve inequalities.

items.objective: Solve linear equations incl. with brackets on one side
items.success_criteria: Inverse operations; check by substitution.

items.objective: Represent and solve simple inequalities
items.success_criteria: Number line representation; correct solution set.

modules.title: Sequences & Coordinates
modules.summary: Term-to-term rules; nth term; plotting in all four quadrants.

items.objective: Generate sequences and find nth term of linear sequences
items.success_criteria: Correct difference and zero term; test with terms.

items.objective: Plot and read coordinates in four quadrants
items.success_criteria: Use (x,y) order; reflect across axes.

modules.title: 2D Geometry: Angles & Polygons
modules.summary: Angle rules, triangles, quadrilaterals, interior/exterior angles.

items.objective: Use angle facts on lines, at a point, vertically opposite
items.success_criteria: State reasons clearly; work with algebraic expressions.

items.objective: Angles in triangles/quadrilaterals; interior angles of polygons
items.success_criteria: Apply (n-2)*180 and exterior angle sum 360°.

modules.title: Measure: Perimeter, Area & Volume
modules.summary: Area of rectangles/triangles/parallelograms; circles; volume of prisms.

items.objective: Perimeter and area of composite 2D shapes
items.success_criteria: Correct units; decompose shapes; show workings.

items.objective: Circumference and area of circles
items.success_criteria: Use πr² and 2πr correctly; round sensibly.

items.objective: Volume and surface area of right prisms
items.success_criteria: Use area of cross-section × length; include units³.

items.objective: Perform and describe reflections, rotations, translations
items.success_criteria: Fully specify line/centre/angle/vector.

items.objective: Enlarge shapes with integer scale factor and centre
items.success_criteria: Use rays from centre; count squares for factor.

modules.title: Probability
modules.summary: Theoretical vs experimental probability; sample space diagrams.

items.objective: Calculate probabilities of single events
items.success_criteria: Values between 0 and 1; complementary events to 1.

items.objective: Use sample space tables for combined events
items.success_criteria: List outcomes systematically; find exact probabilities.

modules.title: Statistics
modules.summary: Collecting data, averages, range, bar/line/pie charts; misleading graphs.

items.objective: Calculate mean, median, mode and range
items.success_criteria: Choose appropriate average; justify choice.

items.objective: Represent data clearly and interpret charts
items.success_criteria: Accurate scales/labels; critique misleading examples.

modules.title: Problem Solving & Reasoning
modules.summary: Multi-step problems integrating number, algebra and geometry.

items.objective: Apply strategies (draw, table, bar model, work backwards)
items.success_criteria: Explain steps; check with estimation.

items.objective: Communicate reasoning
items.success_criteria: Use correct vocabulary and units; justify conclusions.
